outages.description: Russian strikes on energy infrastructure caused power outages that significantly reduced Internet traffic from Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk Oblast.
A network fault caused a near-total loss of Internet traffic from Claro Dominicana (AS6400), affecting fixed and mobile services.
A power plant failure at WEB Aruba caused a significant drop in Internet traffic from SETAR (AS11816), Aruba's main telecom provider.
